run_inference_on_dataset: run inference on a Detectron model across all configured test datasets with optional multi-gpu support
test_net_on_dataset: test a Detectron network on a single dataset and return evaluation results for boxes, masks, keypoints, and body UV
test_net_single_gpu: run single GPU inference on all images in a dataset or an index range and save detections to a pickle file
initialize_model_from_cfg: initialize a Detectron model from the global config by loading test-time weights and creating Caffe2 networks
get_roidb_and_dataset: get the region of interest database for a dataset optionally restricted to a range of image indices
